messages.text: Warm Fog, Ancient Meteorites, and Election Day Prep
A foggy but warm Tuesday will see a high near 81°F. Voters prepare for upcoming local millage decisions, while scientists reveal insights from ancient Martian meteorites and the early solar system.
Expect fog today with a high near 81°F and a low around 56°F; there is a 3% chance of precipitation.
Sunrise is at 7:10 AM and sunset at 5:25 PM, with the moon in its Last Quarter phase, 34.9% illuminated.
There are no specific local events listed for today. Consider reviewing upcoming dates for local meetings.
The next local calendar item is the 862 Meeting on November 4th at 6:30 PM.
Local Millages on the Ballot for Wayne and Oakland Counties

Voters in Wayne and Oakland counties will decide on millages for the Charles H. Wright Museum of African American History and the Detroit Historical Society. These would allow for free admission and expanded outreach.
Looking Ahead: Meteor Showers and New Discoveries
